messages:
Alex: quick heads-up — noticed console CPU spike when inspect + full-request-logging is enabled for >5% of sessions. suspect sticky sampling is keeping sessions pinned and preventing graceful evictions.
Maria: ugh. saw that too in the heatmap. is it only on high-traffic tenants or everywhere? :thinking:
Alex: mostly tenants with long-lived websocket sessions. single tenant was holding ~12k sticky samples, TTL didn't expire because session id persisted.
Jamal: can you paste the config we're using?
Alex: here's the relevant snippet from the rollout config we pushed last week:
```json
{"sampling": {"mode": "sticky", "session_ttl_sec": 86400, "max_samples_per_tenant": 10000, "fallback": "staged-redact"}}
```
Sophia: oh — `staged-redact` fallback will still keep raw request for 24h until redaction job runs. that plus sticky = big memory/IO churn.
Maria: two ideas: 1) reduce session_ttl to 15m for inspectable routes, 2) change sticky semantics to 'sticky-on-first-touch' (persist pointer, not full payload), or 3) make fallback redact-in-flight (best-effort) for high cardinality tenants.
Jamal: prefer option 2 + short ttl. 'pointer' approach stores only provenance + small fingerprint, then fetch payload on-demand if an engineer clicks inspect. less IO and still debuggable.
Alex: pointer approach has UX hit — clicking inspect would possibly trigger a cold fetch that might be redacted or missing if redaction job already ran. ops experience might suffer.
Sophia: can we do hybrid? sticky pointer for 12h, raw kept only if route has `inspect:always` flag. otherwise store hash+meta and queue redaction faster for high-risk tenants.
Maria: practical immediate change: flip inspectable routes to ttl=900 (15m) and add a canary with pointer-mode for one large tenant tomorrow. I'll open a quick console flag.
Jamal: SG. also let's add a telemetry counter: `sample_mode_resolution` with labels {mode, tenant_tier, action} so we can measure fetch misses and extra redact runs. Put a burn-in dashboard panel.
Alex: created quick Datadog widget draft: https://app.datadog.example/dash/xyz — shows sticky count, pointer-miss-rate, redact-queue-latency.
Sophia: sounds good. one more: we need an audit trail when raw is retained beyond 24h (legal asks). add event `retained_raw_explicit` with reason.
Maria: noted. I'll do short PR to change ttl + add telemetry + canary flag. can we aim to deploy the ttl change as a config flip today?
Jamal: I can flip config and watch the dashboards. ping me when you flip. :eyes:
Alex: thanks all — followup in this thread after canary warms. ops-bot: deploy status please.
ops-bot: deploy queued: config-change-sticky-ttl -> prod-canary (rollout 5%). ETA 3m.
Alex: perfect.
